'''Banlon''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] living on [[Makeb]] during the [[Galactic War]]. During the [[Conquest of Makeb]] in [[3638 BBY]] he tried to take a shuttle full of refugees from collapsing Makeb mesas to safety, but before he could take off the shuttle was shot down by [[InterStellar Regulators]]' heavy artillery, killing everyone onboard, including Banlon.
